heading: About Me
subheading: A frontend developer who loves turning designs into fast, beautiful websites.
bio: I'm Akash Kumar Gouda, a Frontend Developer currently working at Inflexi Technologies Private Limited. I design, build and manage websites — with a strong focus on eCommerce stores, product design and product data.

My day-to-day work covers everything from designing pages in Figma and Photoshop to building them with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS and React, and managing storefronts on BigCommerce. I enjoy taking a design and making it pixel-perfect, responsive and easy to maintain.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
points: Design, develop and manage client websites with a focus on eCommerce.
Build and maintain BigCommerce storefronts, themes and email templates.
Manage eCommerce product design and product data across websites.
Delivered frontend designs for handiquilter.com.au, pfaff.com.au and 4pointsdigital.com.au.

experience.title: Tour & Travel Website
points: Built a complete tour and travel website with a working booking system.
Designed responsive listing, detail and booking pages.
